about.title: Training built on scientific foundations
about.lead: ABA Demy is an Arabic-language platform specialized in Applied Behavior Analysis, combining specialized training, scientific resources, and a professional community — to meet practitioners' needs and support families with services and consultations grounded in best practice.
about.paragraph: Our model combines live theoretical instruction, hands-on supervision, and continuous professional assessment in line with international standards. It is delivered by internationally certified Syrian experts who bring global expertise and adapt it to the local Syrian context.

origin.title: A story that began from a real need

items.label: The Reality
items.text: Amid rising demand for evidence-based interventions in Syria, there is a clear shortage of specialized training, Arabic-language resources, and professional services that practitioners and families need.

items.label: The Challenge
items.text: Practitioners faced limited opportunities for professional development and specialized qualification, while families struggled to access professional services to support their children with developmental disabilities early on.

items.label: This Is Where ABA Demy Began
items.text: To become one of the first specialized platforms in Syria, bringing together specialized training, educational resources, professional supervision, and family support services.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: We respect your privacy. This page explains in plain words what data we collect, why, and who it passes through.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: ABA Demy is an academy that trains Applied Behavior Analysis practitioners. For any question about your data, write to: ⁦info@aba-demy.com⁩

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.text: When you fill in the registration or contact form we collect: your name, email, phone or WhatsApp number, city, professional background (optional), the program you chose, and your message. We do not ask for payment details and we do not collect sensitive data.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.text: We use it to answer your request and to contact you about programs, cohort dates and registration. We do not sell your data, and we do not send you marketing messages without your consent.

sections.title: Who your data passes through
sections.text: Forms are sent through Web3Forms (a third-party service) to our email inbox. The website is hosted on Cloudflare and its files are stored on GitHub. If you contact us on WhatsApp, the conversation is governed by WhatsApp's policy. We share your data with these providers only as far as needed to run the site and receive your request.

sections.title: Cart and browser storage
sections.text: The site keeps your shopping cart in your own browser only; nothing reaches us unless you send the order to us on WhatsApp. We do not use advertising trackers. The site loads fonts from Google Fonts, so Google may receive your connection address (IP) for that purpose. Cloudflare may use technical cookies to protect the site.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: We keep your messages for as long as needed to reply to you and manage registration, then we delete them.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can ask us at any time to see, correct or delete your data by writing to: ⁦info@aba-demy.com⁩

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this page when needed; the date of the last update is shown at the top.
